scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron electron"
scripts.start:electron: npm run build && npm run build:electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron electron
scripts.package:extension: npm run build:extension && cd extension && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository --no-dependencies
scripts.build:extension: npm install --prefix extension && npm run compile --prefix extension
